name: checkout-sandbox
description: Automated checkout rehearsal in isolated Chrome — extension smoke (CI) plus optional Target product→review rehearsal
goals: npm run test:extension green in scripts/browser-smoke (ephemeral profile)
checkout-rehearsal.mjs reaches review or documents blockedReason
Never auto place order; autoPlaceOrder false in rehearsal
nonGoals: Auto place order or real purchases
Secrets or passwords in scripts or task JSON
Headed Chrome in default cloud CI without Xvfb
technicalNotes: Headed Playwright Chromium required. Load target-checkout-helper/ unpacked via launch-util.mjs. Read .cursor/skills/extension-e2e-test/SKILL.md for Puppeteer patterns. Rehearsal env: TCH_PRODUCT_URL, TCH_PROFILE_DIR, TCH_REHEARSAL_TIMEOUT_MS, TCH_MANUAL_WAIT_SECS.
_priority_order: 3. signin-step unit coverage for checkout paths
_step_size: One logical change per commit. Quality over speed.
